# Bootstrap 5.3.8

CSS is vendored locally. JavaScript uses the official bootstrap npm package's ES module, bundled by Vite. No runtime CDN requests.

- Source: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/getting-started/introduction/
- License: bootstrap.LICENSE (MIT).
- CSS SHA384: sRIl4kxILFvY47J16cr9ZwB07vP4J8+LH7qKQnuqkuIAvNWLzeN8tE5YBujZqJLB

Keep CSS and the bootstrap npm dependency at the same version. Verify the CSS hash and run browser checks at desktop, tablet and mobile widths.
